title: Divided Differences
read_scope: Partial inspection: §2 continuity; §9 contour Eq51 p63 and Hermite–Genocchi Eq52 pp63–64. Not complete reading or technical audit.
reusable_result: Eq51 represents a divided difference by the contour integral of F over the node polynomial; Eq52 represents it as a simplex integral of the corresponding derivative. Both extend to repeated nodes and supply the exact local grouped-residue identity.
scope_limit: Only the stated representation and relevant portions inspected; no full-paper audit.

title: Exponential Riesz bases of subspaces and divided differences
read_scope: Partial inspection: Definition1,Eq4,Theorem2 and its proof; Lemma5 and proof pp14–15. No full-paper reading/audit.
venue: arXiv primary preprint version inspected; journal metadata not separately verified
reusable_result: Exponential divided differences extend continuously through collisions and remain independent (Theorem2). Lemma5 bounds finite-cluster Gram matrices and inverses uniformly in bounded frequency discs in an upper strip, in L²(0,infinity), using compactness.
scope_limit: Our L²(0,1) real-frequency theorem is separately proved; Lemma5 is not quoted as a direct theorem for that different domain. Global Riesz-basis hypotheses are not established for zeta zeros.
